name: Human Anatomy — Easy
description: Common bones, organs, and tissues named in six to ten letters.

words.hint: Flat breastbone at the front of the chest
Windpipe carrying air toward the lungs
One of five long bones in the palm of the hand
Shoulder blade on the upper back
Long bone of the upper arm
Bean-shaped organ that filters blood into urine
Tough band joining muscle to bone
Collarbone linking the arm to the trunk
Single bone segment of the spinal column
Flexible connective tissue at joints and the ears
Membrane that vibrates with incoming sound
Front arm muscle that flexes the elbow
Largest part of the brain, seat of thought
